lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular blobs arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns, with 4 to 6 blobs per column, forming a regular 2D grid on the lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light superior ridge and a shadowed inferior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least six remoras (Echeneidae) attached to the subject, including one on the upper posterior flank and five clustered around the right pectoral fin.
